summary_zh: 认知科学家 Lera Boroditsky 通过跨语言实验揭示：我们所说的语言深刻塑造着思维方式——从空间方位、时间感知到颜色判断，不同语言的使用者以截然不同的方式理解世界。这场演讲让我们重新审视「思考」本身。
summary_en: Cognitive scientist Lera Boroditsky reveals through cross-linguistic experiments how the language we speak profoundly shapes our thinking — from spatial orientation and time perception to color judgment. Different language speakers understand the world in fundamentally different ways, challenging us to rethink "thinking" itself.
